item.title: Door Hinge HH-003
item.description:
|## Model HH-003 — Heavy Duty Butt Hinge

Product Overview

This HH-003 butt hinge is built for real work. After 10 years shipping hardware into Nigeria, I can tell you — this is the hinge you want for your commercial and residential projects. Solid construction, handles the weight, no sagging after months of use. We’ve sent container loads of these to Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt — they hold up.

Why Nigerian Contractors Pick This Hinge

Handles the humidity. Lagos humidity is no joke. That’s why we offer stainless steel and brass options — they don’t rust or pit like cheap mild steel hinges do after one rainy season. Go with 304 stainless for exterior doors, brass for that premium feel in reception areas and offices.

item.title: Door Hinge HH-004
item.description:
|## Model HH-004 — Premium Butt Hinge (Wide Application)

Product Overview

HH-004 is our most versatile door hinge. Same rugged build as the HH-003 but with expanded sizing options for larger doors and heavier traffic applications. I’ve personally overseen thousands of these shipped to Nigeria — estate developers love them because one hinge model works across multiple door types on their projects.

Built for the Nigerian Market

Expanded size range. While HH-003 covers standard doors, HH-004 goes bigger. Need hinges for 8-foot commercial doors? Wide-format entryways? This is your hinge. Extra knuckles for better weight distribution on heavy doors.

item.title: Door Hinge HH-005
item.description:
|## Model HH-005 — Heavy Duty Security Hinge

Product Overview

The HH-005 is what I recommend when security matters. This isn’t your standard butt hinge — it’s beefed up for doors that need to stay put. After a decade sending hardware to Nigeria, I know that security hardware is non-negotiable. This hinge has thicker leaves, heavier-gauge steel, and a design that makes it much harder to tamper with.

Security-First Design

Thicker leaf gauge. The HH-005 uses 3.0mm thick material compared to the standard 2.5mm. That extra half millimeter makes a real difference in preventing door sag and resisting forced entry.

item.title: Door Hinge HH-006
item.description:
|## Model HH-006 — Decorative Butt Hinge

Product Overview

The HH-006 is where function meets style. Same SOLA quality you expect, but with decorative finials and a more refined profile. After 10 years in this business, I’ve noticed Nigerian property developers are putting more attention on interior finishes — and the hardware matters. The HH-006 gives you that premium look without sacrificing strength.

What Makes HH-006 Different

Decorative finials. Top and bottom finials add a classic, premium appearance. These aren’t glued-on plastic pieces — they’re solid metal, same material as the hinge body, machined and finished to match.
